title: FINDING PERFECT PEACE
IN HIS PRESENCE
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: white dove resting in soft light
soft golden dust motes in church

scenes.a: If the thoughts racing through your mind feel heavy tonight, please stay here for prayer.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
Lord, anchor my heart in this moment as I release the tension I have been holding.
I bring my scattered thoughts to you, asking for the stillness that only you provide.
May your presence settle over my spirit as I rest in your promise, amen.
